scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --filter api exec prisma db seed
scripts.infra:up: brew services start postgresql@16 && echo 'PostgreSQL started'
scripts.infra:down: brew services stop postgresql@16 && echo 'PostgreSQL stopped'
scripts.setup:win: pnpm infra:up:win && pnpm install && pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed && start pnpm db:studio
scripts.up:win: pnpm infra:up:win && pnpm install && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm dev
